ram: 1463160 KiB MemTotal observed; QEMU 1430 MiB is an approximation, not the reserved-memory map

MI_DISP and MI_OSD initialization, IOMMU allocation and layer visibility still need hardware validation

virtio-snd substitutes for MI_PCM/AOUT routing; ALSA card/device/rates on target remain unverified
virtio keyboard/rng/net and PL011/PL031 replace target peripherals
guest frame rate and boot time do not predict TV performance
